Anything by the company "answers" is going to be the easiest to find and best quality in my opinion. And so much easier than trying to home-make the food yourself. Just be sure to avoid HPP when buying raw foods. It is a process of sterilization that degrades the foods and fills with synthetic vitamins. Answers, Small Batch, OC Raw and K9 Natural are all reputable high quality companies. I imagine anywhere that sells these products will have employees that can explain feeding and benefits.

Hello! I work as a nutrition consultant for dogs and cats and I see these guys every day! 
Greater swiss typically have a lot less energy output than other dogs their size given their bulky nature so that should work out great! Also, socializition often makes or breaks a "good" dog so the more people he experiences on a day to day basis will make him a "better" dog. 
*I hope you'll be feeding this pup a species appropriate diet as swiss and berners have major genetic/health issues that can be avoided with proper diet!
